learning_goal: Enable Grade 7 learners to understand and apply the central ideas of Light: Shadows and Reflections.

explanation_sections.title: Activate
explanation_sections.explanation: Connect the chapter to prior knowledge, observation or experience.

explanation_sections.title: Build
explanation_sections.explanation: Teach from the source-grounded points and examples.
source_evidence: Light: Shadows and 11 Reflections In the Western Ghat region of Maharashtra, Keshav spends part of his summer vacation at his friend Jatin’s grandparents’ village.
Having lived in a big city, he ﬁnds the forests, fresh air, sounds of gushing streams, and chirping birds a novel experience.
However, for Keshav, the most fascinating sight is the dance of hundreds of ﬁreﬂies at night, ﬂashing their lights in a wonderful performance.
Jatin’s grandparents explain that ﬁreﬂies are seasonal insects and they use light to communicate.
Unfortunately, Keshav also learns the number of ﬁreﬂies is decreasing due to light pollution, reduced forest cover, and excessive tourism.

explanation_sections.title: Reason
explanation_sections.explanation: Ask learners to explain relationships, evidence, patterns or steps.

explanation_sections.title: Transfer
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from the textbook context to a closely related new situation.

misconceptions: Confusing an example with the underlying concept.
checks_for_understanding: What changes if an important condition changes?
closure: Learner states the central idea, supporting evidence and one application.
